name: dual_infeasible_3x3
description: 3x3 SDP: max X_11 s.t. X_22 = 1, X_33 = 1, X >= 0. The primal is UNBOUNDED (X_11 grows freely while X_22, X_33 are pinned), so the DUAL is infeasible. A larger (3x3) instance of dual infeasibility to exercise the detector beyond 2x2; solver reports DUAL_INFEASIBLE in 4 iters at prec=128.
witness: Recession ray Xhat = E_11: <A_1,Xhat> = 0 (A_1 = E_22), <A_2,Xhat> = 0 (A_2 = E_33), <C,Xhat> = 1 > 0 (C = E_11), Xhat >= 0 (eigs 1,0,0). Primal unboundedness along Xhat certifies dual infeasibility.
